column1: # Ash Jenna's two fights: the optional super boss in Vale and the one at Suhalla Gate.

column3:
Vale hasn't changed.
I remember the roads.
I remember the faces.{page_break}I fought in another
world once, Isaac.
But this was my home.{end_wait}
Then why are you here?\nThese are people\nyou grew up with.{end_wait}

That's why I'm here.
I know their names.
I know where they live.{page_break}And I know what
it would do to you
if I hurt them.{end_wait}

Still protecting them.
You haven't changed
at all, Isaac.{page_break}Go home. Your mother
is waiting for you.
I remember her, too.{end_wait}

Look at these soldiers.
All that courage,
and none of it mattered.{page_break}I could finish them.
But watching you choose
who to save is better.{end_wait}

Get away from them.
Your fight is with me.{page_break}You want me to choose
who gets left behind.
I know your game.{end_wait}

Oh, Isaac. You still
think you get to
make the rules?{page_break}Then come closer.
Let's see how many
more I can break.{end_wait}

You beat me, Isaac.
Does that make you
feel like a hero?{page_break}Those men are still
bleeding. Go on.
Save them.{page_break}I'll remember how
easy you are to hurt.{end_wait}
